judge.rationale: The candidate implements the feature using completely wrong protocol names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage`) instead of the issue's explicitly specified names (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationListMessage`). It also directly violates several core requirements and acceptance criteria: it omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config altogether, omits `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, and returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `store.listFor` is missing instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error as explicitly required. Furthermore, `validateMessage` in the candidate allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` whereas the ticket requires rejecting `limit: 0` and `limit: 201` (1–200 inclusive), and it logs `error.message` on store failure which risks leaking connection credentials. Finally, the candidate leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository and misses the required documentation updates in `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`.
